objective: Fix census rows 1 and 3 of docs/analysis/e01-lifecycle-downstream-consumers-2026-10-03.md section B1-L (user-authorized 2026-10-03, atomic: direction/event only). ExecutionPlannerV1_2._derive_intent labels LIQ_SWEEP from the unsigned sweep_detected OR the C04 condition double_sweep, never comparing the swept side's implied bias with selected_direction. Under the MKT-E01 contract a sweep-reversal entry needs a sweep EVENT on the bar whose implied bias (UPPER swept -> SHORT, LOWER swept -> LONG) equals the trade direction. Add strict execution_planner.liq_sweep_semantics: legacy_unsigned (current behaviour, byte-identical, declared on every live config) | e01_direction_aligned (LIQ_SWEEP iff liquidity_sweep != 0 and -sign(liquidity_sweep) == selected_direction; double_sweep no longer triggers the intent). NOT in scope: the GateIntelligence C04 bonus (row 2), gate arithmetic, PULLBACK / OQ7 (row 4), the dead liquidity-score half (row 5).
